skills.name: Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting two fractions that share a common denominator.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer/whole-number parts of mixed or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing from Whole
skills.definition: Borrowing units from the whole number part to resolve a negative fraction subtraction step.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the resulting fraction to its lowest terms.
